history.summary: A Hanuman shrine in Gonda city, listed as 'New Hanuman Garhi' at Veer Pur, Civil Line, Gonda (271001), with JustDial listing hours and ratings; a visitor video describes it as a large Hanuman temple 'popularly known as Hanuman Gadhi' with Sundarkand recitals every Tuesday. FLAG: no construction date or formal history found in any source; identity is matched on the Civil Line listing and geocode ('Hanuman, Jail Road, Civil Line, Gonda') but should be confirmed as the CSV's intended shrine. Not to be confused with the famous Hanuman Garhi at Ayodhya. CSV 'state' column held the town name; corrected to Uttar Pradesh (Gonda is in Uttar Pradesh). No Gonda-specific image found (searches returned only Ayodhya images), so media is empty.

name: Hanuman Garhi Temple
town_description: Gonda is a city in eastern Uttar Pradesh and the headquarters of Gonda district in the Devipatan division. It is a regional trade and rail junction with several local temples and shrines, including the Prithvinath temple nearby at Khargupur.

travel.road: Civil Line, Gonda city, on the Gonda-Balrampur-Tulsipur road; local buses and autos
